title: A write-off reason the line’s own records contradict
assertion: The Reason starts on “Choose the reason”, and a write-off with no reason chosen is refused on Reason; “Window passed” is neither offered nor accepted for a line whose dispute window is open or unknown, and is refused on Reason with nothing written; once the window has ended it is offered and recorded
noFileReason: A case line on a synthetic practice the test creates, written off: no file.
